pipelineMust: Use Node's streaming UTF-8 decoder before eventsource-parser so a code point split across byte chunks is preserved
Propagate transport rejection or abort separately from framed SSE events
componentMust: Frame decoded SSE fields and event boundaries according to the WHATWG event-stream grammar
Deliver data payloads exactly enough for a separate protocol adapter to interpret
componentNeedNot: Decode transport bytes or detect socket/AbortSignal failure
Interpret OpenRouter finish_reason, usage, error, or [DONE] semantics
Perform MC-06 accounting, retry, cancellation, or unknown-effect policy

scenarios.input: Valid SSE with Chinese and emoji JSON data, delivered one byte at a time
scenarios.expected: One event; data equals the original decoded payload exactly

scenarios.input: Same multibyte UTF-8 payload split at fixed non-code-point byte offsets
scenarios.expected: Same event as the unsplit reference

scenarios.input: CRLF and LF line endings, comment, and repeated data fields
scenarios.expected: Comment is surfaced through onComment; data lines join with LF

scenarios.input: Two complete data events in one transport chunk
A data frame whose payload is [DONE]
scenarios.expected: Parser surfaces literal [DONE]; it does not assign protocol meaning

scenarios.input: A finish_reason JSON frame, usage tail frame, and repeated finish frame
scenarios.expected: All three data payloads are surfaced in order without deduplication or settlement

scenarios.input: Syntactically valid SSE containing invalid JSON text
scenarios.expected: Parser surfaces the payload; JSON validation remains the adapter's responsibility

scenarios.input: SSE data payload containing an OpenRouter-style error object
scenarios.expected: Parser surfaces the payload; error classification remains the adapter's responsibility

scenarios.input: A data field without a blank-line event terminator, then EOF
scenarios.expected: No event is emitted at EOF

scenarios.input: One complete JSON data event without a protocol finish marker, then EOF
scenarios.expected: One event is framed, but no finish inference is available from the component

scenarios.input: Loopback HTTP response writes one complete event and part of a second, then destroys its socket
scenarios.expected: Fetch body iteration rejects; server socket destruction is observed; only the complete event is emitted

scenarios.input: Loopback HTTP response writes one complete event, waits, and the client aborts its fetch
scenarios.expected: Fetch body iteration rejects with abort; server observes request/socket closure; only the complete event is emitted
